claimText: Für Elise (theme, arranged for this app) - the pickup and bars 1-8 of WoO 59, with a single-pass ending

differenceNotes: bar 8: a whole 3/8 bar (1 1/2 quarters) instead of the source's first-ending bar of 1 quarter - declared departure (single-pass ending)
bar 8: no repeat sign - declared departure (no repeat back to the start)
bar 8: no first-ending bracket - declared departure (single-pass ending)
bar 8, beat 0: the final A4 is a dotted quarter instead of a quarter - declared departure (held to fill the bar)

outcomeNote: Checked 2026-09-24 against Mutopia 931 (Breitkopf & Härtel, 1888): the pickup and bars 1-7 match on every aspect (pitch, onset, duration, spelling, bar lengths, no repeats or grace notes), and the source reading matches its own MIDI. Bar 8 differs only by the declared single-pass ending. No note changed; the sidecar now lists the departures.
